# Dispatch Order — Parallel Agent Build (4 Agents)

## How to Use These Files

Open Antigravity's **Manager View** and dispatch ALL agents at the same time.
Give each agent their task file as the opening prompt.

## Dispatch All at Once

For each agent below, open a new workspace and paste the **one-liner prompt**. The agent will read its full task file and brain files automatically.

---

**Agent 1 — Foundation**
```
Read and execute .gemini/antigravity/brain/agents/AGENT-1-foundation.md — then read every file in .gemini/antigravity/brain/ for context. Follow the build order exactly.
```
Builds: design system, layout, header/footer, shared components (laptop card, deal badge, price display, comparison tray, skeletons, empty states), homepage.

**Agent 2 — API + Data**
```
Read and execute .gemini/antigravity/brain/agents/AGENT-2-api.md — then read every file in .gemini/antigravity/brain/ for context. Follow the build order exactly.
```
Builds: all API routes, retailer adapters (16 sources), cron pipeline, Gemini spec normalizer, deal rating computation, seed data.

**Agent 3 — Features A (Core Browsing)**
```
Read and execute .gemini/antigravity/brain/agents/AGENT-3-features-a.md — then read every file in .gemini/antigravity/brain/ for context. Follow the build order exactly.
```
Builds: category pages (Work/Gaming/Apple), spec & brand filtering, sorting, search with typeahead.

**Agent 4 — Features B (Deals, Detail, Comparison)**
```
Read and execute .gemini/antigravity/brain/agents/AGENT-4-features-b.md — then read every file in .gemini/antigravity/brain/ for context. Follow the build order exactly.
```
Builds: laptop detail page, Top Deals, Budget Picks, Best Rated, side-by-side comparison.

All agents start simultaneously. No waiting between them.

## Why This Works Without a Supervisor

Every agent reads the same brain files (spec, tokens, copy, API contract, UI rules).
The brain files ARE the coordination layer — they define exact CSS variable names,
exact API route paths, exact component patterns. As long as every agent follows
the brain files, their output fits together.

Each agent owns specific files and cannot touch files owned by others.
No two agents create the same file, so there are no merge conflicts.

## File Ownership Map

| Path Pattern | Owner |
|---|---|
| `src/components/layout/*` | Agent 1 (Foundation) |
| `src/components/shared/*` | Agent 1 (Foundation) |
| `src/components/ui/*` | Agent 1 (Foundation) |
| `src/app/layout.tsx`, `globals.css` | Agent 1 (Foundation) |
| `src/app/page.tsx` | Agent 1 (Foundation) |
| `src/app/api/**/*` | Agent 2 (API) |
| `src/lib/retailers/*` | Agent 2 (API) |

| `prisma/seed.ts` | Agent 2 (API) |
| `src/app/(features)/work/*` | Agent 3 (Features A) |
| `src/app/(features)/gaming/*` | Agent 3 (Features A) |
| `src/app/(features)/apple/*` | Agent 3 (Features A) |
| `src/app/(features)/search/*` | Agent 3 (Features A) |
| `src/components/features/browsing/*` | Agent 3 (Features A) |
| `src/components/features/filters/*` | Agent 3 (Features A) |
| `src/components/features/search/*` | Agent 3 (Features A) |
| `src/app/(features)/laptop/[slug]/*` | Agent 4 (Features B) |
| `src/app/(features)/deals/*` | Agent 4 (Features B) |
| `src/app/(features)/budget-picks/*` | Agent 4 (Features B) |
| `src/app/(features)/best-rated/*` | Agent 4 (Features B) |
| `src/app/(features)/compare/*` | Agent 4 (Features B) |
| `src/components/features/detail/*` | Agent 4 (Features B) |
| `src/components/features/comparison/*` | Agent 4 (Features B) |
| `prisma/schema.prisma` | Nobody (already deployed) |
| `src/lib/db.ts` | Nobody (already configured) |
| `.gemini/antigravity/brain/*` | Nobody (Cowork manages) |

## After All Agents Finish

1. Run `npm run build` — catches TypeScript errors or import mismatches
2. Run `npm test` — unit tests
3. Run `npm run test:e2e` — end-to-end tests
4. Run `/ag-harden` in Cowork — production readiness audit

If the build fails, it's usually a small integration issue (a missing import, a
slightly different prop name). Fix it directly in Antigravity or run `/ag-sync`
from Cowork to identify and resolve.
